name: pi-rolecast
description: Multi-agent role framework for Pi. Groups of specialist agents (coding, video, etc.) bound to per-role models, dispatched via pi-subagents. Profile-driven, gate-verified, language-agnostic.

scripts.test: tsx --test tests/unit/test_extension.ts tests/unit/test_model_resolver.ts tests/unit/test_profile_loader.ts tests/unit/test_contracts.ts tests/unit/test_dump_bindings.ts tests/unit/test_scaffolder.ts tests/unit/test_gate_runner.ts tests/unit/test_sync_settings.ts tests/unit/test_a2_a3_a5_injection.ts tests/integration/test_dynamic_binding_smoke.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
